CustomField.description: With Merge Households With Members on, merge a household that still has members only when every remaining member's mailing street (first line) and five-digit postal code match the kept contact's mailing address after the merge. Case, punctuation and ZIP+4 are ignored. A kept contact without a mailing street never matches.
